description: Reserve a listing for the signed-in buyer and get a one-time NEAR Intents deposit address and the exact amount of `pay_with` to send. Nothing is charged by this call: the purchase completes only when the buyer's own wallet sends that exact amount to that address before the deadline. Returns a checkout_id, the deposit address, exact amount, asset, chain and the pay_before deadline. If the seller accepted the buyer's offer, the agreed price is used. Requires a Port66 session (Authorization: Bearer token from wallet sign-in). Then poll purchase_status until it is `paid`.

chain.description: Only needed when the asset exists on several chains: ETH and USDC on Ethereum, Arbitrum or Base, USDC also on NEAR. Omit it otherwise.

id.description: The listing's id, exactly as returned in the `id` field of search_listings results (a slug such as 'kaws-x-sesame-street-water-parade-elmo-figure').

pay_with.description: The crypto asset the buyer pays with. payment_options lists which chains each one is accepted on.

refund_to.description: The buyer's own wallet address on the paying chain (for example a 0x address for Ethereum or Base, a Solana address for SOL). If the payment cannot complete, the funds are returned here. Never an exchange deposit address.

name: start_purchase
title: Start a purchase
